summary: Pharaoh dreamed of seven fat cows eaten by seven skinny cows. Joseph explained that God was warning of seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine, and he gave a wise plan.

story_reel.narration: One night, Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had a strange dream. Seven fat, healthy cows came up out of the Nile River. Then seven skinny, bony cows came up and ate the fat ones! Then Pharaoh had a second dream: seven plump heads of grain were swallowed up by seven thin, dried-up heads. In the morning, Pharaoh called all his wise men, but no one could explain the dreams. Then the cupbearer suddenly remembered. 'There's a young Hebrew man in prison who explains dreams!' Pharaoh sent for Joseph right away. Joseph shaved, changed his clothes, and stood before the king. Pharaoh said, 'I hear you can explain dreams.' Joseph said, 'It isn't me. God will give Pharaoh the answer.' Joseph explained: 'Both dreams mean the same thing. God is showing you what He's about to do. There will be seven years of plenty, then seven years of famine.' Then Joseph gave a plan: 'Choose a wise man to store up grain during the good years, so there will be food during the famine.' God gave Joseph wisdom to solve a problem for a whole nation.

memory_verse.text: It isn't in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh gives me wisdom to solve problems and help others.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God gave Joseph wisdom to solve a big problem. What is a problem you'd like God to help you think through?

quiz.question: What did Pharaoh see in his first dream?
options: Seven fat cows eaten by seven skinny cows
quiz.explanation: Seven fat cows came up out of the river, then seven thin cows ate them.

quiz.question: Who reminded Pharaoh about Joseph?
quiz.explanation: The chief cupbearer remembered Joseph and told Pharaoh about him.

quiz.question: What did the dreams mean?
options: The Nile would dry up forever
Seven years of plenty, then seven years of famine
quiz.explanation: Joseph explained there would be seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You for giving wisdom to those who ask. Help me use my mind to solve problems and help others, and help me give You the credit like Joseph did. Amen.

companion.message: Standing before Pharaoh, I knew I didn't have the answer myself. But God did! When you face a hard problem, ask Him for wisdom.
